**ROBUST_Z** is the modified z-score cut used by the `--outlier robust` rule in `tools/pancake/abtest.py`:

```python
ROBUST_Z = 3.5   # modified z-score cut (Iglewicz & Hoaglin 1993: |0.6745 (x - median) / MAD| > 3.5)
```

It is the threshold on the modified z-score of a measurement: a value counts as a robust outlier when `|x - median| > ROBUST_Z × max(1.4826·MAD, ROBUST_FLOOR × median)` (see `robust_bounds()` / `robust_keep()`, which judge each row against the rows of the same arm, case and request slot, dropping a whole pass that contains an outlier row). It is used only when the group has at least `ROBUST_MIN` values. Together with `ROBUST_FLOOR = 0.025` it gives `SLOW_START = ROBUST_Z × ROBUST_FLOOR = 8.75%`, the distance below an arm's reference start that flags a slow engine state; `power_sim.py` imports the same value from `abtest`.
